doc_summary: `native_server_data_loaded(reload)` fires once the server's data tables are built (NeoForge's `TagsUpdatedEvent` with `SERVER_DATA_LOAD`): the recipes, tags, loot and advancements of the world's data packs and of `native_data_pack_files` are what the helpers read from then on. `reload` is false on a world's first open, before its chunks and players are loaded, and true after `/reload`, once the players were sent the new data. It is where a mod drops caches derived from the data and rebinds what depends on it. Server-side, the single player's integrated server included; a client connected to a server never fires it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_data_loaded@.
